description:
Replace the current verdict review body (decision word at character ~164, after a status heading with a 40-hex SHA and a boilerplate sentence; reviewer notes are 84-91% of every SHIP) with the proposal's layout (section 8.3), for every state: SHIP, SHIP WITH FIXES (threaded and threadless findings), DO NOT SHIP (reason stays visible), not reviewed, carried (with and without findings), owner ruling, refused, withheld, oversize, repost, shadow, step-back round.
Rules:
- Line 1 is `### <mark> <DECISION> · <one fact>`; verdict marks ✅ SHIP, 🔧 SHIP WITH FIXES, ⛔ DO NOT SHIP, ⏳ NOT REVIEWED (YET), 🚫 REFUSED. Headlines with findings say 'N findings block merge'.
- Line 2: severity counts in bold words (e.g. `**5 High · 1 Medium**`), reviewed SHA once, 'changes since' SHA, fixed ids, and the dispute grammar `Dispute: D<n> - <reason>` when findings are open.
- One line per finding: `<mark> **<Severity>** · D<n> · <title ≤ ~90 chars display-only> · <path>`; severity legend 🔴 Critical, 🟠 High, 🟡 Medium, 🔵 Low, ⚪ Advisory; the bold word is always present; Unicode, not shortcodes; sorted most severe first. Threadless findings use a `<details>` whose summary is that line. Still-open findings from earlier reviews appear under `**Still open**`.
- Reviewer notes and run/attempt details go in `<details>`; the 'This result supersedes…' line is removed; staging prefixes such as `.review-promotion/new/` are stripped from displayed paths.
- Hidden markers: `<!-- review-verdict: v2 <state> <40hex> -->` plus the unchanged `<!-- review-protocol: v1 … -->` record, exactly once each.
- Model text placed inside a collapsible neutralises `<details`, `</details>`, `<!--`, `-->`.
Guardrails: the protocol record content and the decision logic are unchanged (only rendering); verdict reviews are never edited after posting (T6); readers from release A must classify every new body (tests against release-A readers); BenchBox readers must already accept the new format (benchbox-review-format-dual-read-20261110 merged) before any BenchBox lock installs this; no live model calls; Theseus merge rule plus independent review (receipt format).
